o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اوغل (oġul), from Proto-Turkic *ogul.
From Russian винт (vint, “screw”), from Polish gwint, from German Gewinde.
From Proto-Turkic *yapïĺč- (“to glue, stick to”). Cognate with Chuvash ҫыпӑҫ (śyp̬ăś) etc. See more cognates at Turkish yapışmak.
From Proto-Turkic *ar- (“weft, woof; warp”), whence also Azerbaijani arğac (“weft, woof”).
From Arabic دَخْل (daḵl). Doublet of taxıl.
